Parterened: Why do women often have jobs while men have careers? And what will it take to build an ecosystem where women can not just start businesses, but grow and lead them?
In this episode, Shaifalika Panda, Founder of Bansidhar & Ila Panda Foundation, joins us for a conversation on women’s economic empowerment, entrepreneurship and building lasting social impact.
• Key highlights from the conversation:*
• From participation to agency: Why women need to move from being beneficiaries to decision-makers.
